specTemplate.name: Pipe Fitting
specTemplate.description: Pipe, butt-weld, sanitary and threaded fittings: body, end connection, size range, pressure class or schedule, material, manufacture, standards.

categories.name: Stainless Steel Pipe Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 304 and 316 stainless steel pipe fittings: 150# cast and 3000# forged threaded fittings, Sch 10 and Sch 40 butt-weld fittings, sanitary clamp and weld fittings, pipe nipples and weld outlets.
categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless pipe fittings: threaded 150# and 3000#, butt-weld Sch 10 and 40, sanitary clamp fittings, nipples and weld outlets.

hero.intro: Threaded, butt-weld and sanitary pipe fittings in 304 and 316 stainless steel, with a size table on every listing.

guidance.heading: Threaded, butt weld or sanitary
guidance.body: Threaded fittings make up quickly without welding; 150# cast fittings suit moderate pressure and 3000# forged fittings higher pressure. Butt-weld fittings give a smooth bore and a joint as strong as the pipe. Sanitary fittings clamp or weld onto polished tube for food and pharmaceutical lines.

standards.heading: Standards
standards.body: Threads are NPT to ASME B1.20.1; forged threaded fittings follow ASME B16.11; butt-weld fittings ASME B16.9 and MSS SP-43 in ASTM A403; sanitary fittings ASTM A269/A270 tube, as the manufacturer states.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.name: Stainless Steel 150# Threaded Pipe Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 304 and 316 stainless steel 150# cast threaded pipe fittings: 45° and 90° elbows, street elbows, tees, crosses, couplings, reducing couplings, hex bushings, unions, caps and plugs.
categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless 150# cast threaded fittings: elbows, tees, crosses, couplings, bushings, unions, caps and plugs, NPT, 1/8" to 4".

hero.intro: Class 150 cast threaded fittings in 304 and 316 stainless steel, NPT.

guidance.heading: Class 150 or 3000
guidance.body: Cast 150# fittings suit water, air and process lines at moderate pressure. Where the line runs at higher pressure, use the forged 3000# range.

standards.heading: NPT threads
standards.body: Threads are NPT to ASME B1.20.1 and seal on the thread flanks with sealant or tape.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.name: Stainless Steel 3000# Forged Threaded Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 304 and 316 stainless steel 3000# forged threaded fittings to ASME B16.11: elbows, street elbows, tees, crosses, couplings, reducing couplings, hex bushings, unions, caps and plugs.
categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless 3000# forged threaded fittings to ASME B16.11: elbows, tees, crosses, couplings, bushings, unions, caps and plugs.

hero.intro: Class 3000 forged threaded fittings in 304 and 316 stainless steel, to ASME B16.11.

guidance.heading: Why forged
guidance.body: Forged fittings are denser and stronger than cast ones, which is why the 3000# class is used on higher-pressure process and hydraulic piping.

standards.heading: ASME B16.11 and ASTM A182
standards.body: Forged threaded fittings are made to ASME B16.11 from ASTM A182 forgings; threads are NPT to ASME B1.20.1.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.name: Stainless Steel Butt-Weld Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 304 and 316 stainless steel butt-weld fittings in Sch 10 and Sch 40: 45° elbows, long- and short-radius 90° elbows, tees, reducing tees, crosses, concentric and eccentric reducers and caps.
categories.seoTitle: Stainless Steel Butt-Weld Fittings, Sch 10 & Sch 40
categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless butt-weld fittings, Sch 10 and Sch 40: elbows, tees, reducing tees, crosses, reducers and caps, 1/2" to 12" NPS.

hero.intro: Butt-weld fittings in 304 and 316 stainless steel, Sch 10 and Sch 40, to ASME B16.9.

guidance.heading: Sch 10 or Sch 40
guidance.body: Match the fitting schedule to the pipe: Sch 10 has a thinner wall for low-pressure and sanitary-adjacent lines, Sch 40 a heavier wall for general process piping. Each fitting is rated to the pipe of the same schedule and grade.

standards.heading: ASME B16.9, MSS SP-43, ASTM A403
standards.body: Butt-weld fittings follow ASME B16.9 (and MSS SP-43 for the light-wall Sch 10 range) in ASTM A403 stainless, as the manufacturer states.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.name: Stainless Steel Sanitary Fittings & Tubing
categories.shortDescription: 304 and 316 stainless steel sanitary fittings: clamp and weld elbows, tees, reducers, ferrules, adapters, caps, gaskets, clamps, hangers, sight glasses, check valves and sanitary tubing.
categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless sanitary fittings: clamp and weld elbows, tees, reducers, ferrules, adapters, gaskets, clamps, hangers and tubing.

hero.intro: Sanitary clamp and weld fittings in 304 and 316 stainless steel, for food, beverage and pharmaceutical lines.

guidance.heading: Clamp or weld
guidance.body: Clamp-end fittings come apart for cleaning and inspection with a clamp and gasket; weld-end fittings are welded into the tube run for a permanent, crevice-free joint. Sizes are the tube outside diameter.

standards.heading: ASTM A269/A270 and 3-A
standards.body: The manufacturer states its sanitary fittings and tubing conform to ASTM A269/A270 and 3-A, and supplies a material test report.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.name: Stainless Steel Pipe Nipples

categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless NPT pipe nipples: Sch 40 welded and Sch 80 seamless, close to 12" long, plus hex and reducing hex nipples.

hero.intro: NPT pipe nipples in 304 and 316 stainless steel, in Sch 40 welded and Sch 80 seamless pipe.

guidance.heading: Choosing a nipple
guidance.body: Pick the pipe size, the schedule (Sch 80 seamless for higher pressure) and the length; each listing gives every length in millimetres.

standards.heading: NPT
standards.body: Threads are NPT to ASME B1.20.1.

items.a: 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it suits seawater, brine and many chemicals; 304 suits fresh water, air and food service. Every fitting is listed in both grades where the manufacturer makes both.

categories.seoDescription: 304 and 316 stainless 3000# forged branch outlets: butt-weld Sch 40 and 80, socket-weld and threaded, plus a weld-on BSPP adapter.

hero.intro: Forged branch outlets and weld-on adapters in 304 and 316 stainless steel.

guidance.heading: Branch outlets
guidance.body: An outlet is welded onto the run pipe over a hole to take a branch without a tee. Pick the branch connection (butt weld, socket weld or threaded) and size; tell us the run pipe size so the outlet saddle fits.

standards.heading: MSS SP-97
standards.body: Integrally reinforced forged branch outlets are made to MSS SP-97 from ASTM A182 forgings.

products.title: 304 Stainless Steel 150# Cast Threaded 45° Elbow
products.focusKeyword: 304 stainless steel 150 cast threaded 45 elbow
products.descriptionShort: 304 Stainless Steel 150# Cast Threaded 45° Elbow. 12 part numbers, 1/8" to 4"; the size table gives the size for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The 304 Stainless Steel 150# Cast Threaded 45° Elbow is a 45° elbow in 304 stainless steel, cast. Cast threaded stainless fittings are the economical choice for water, air, chemical and process lines at moderate pressure, where carbon steel would corrode.

Construction

  • Body: 45° elbow
  • Ends: NPT female thread
  • Material: 304 stainless steel, cast
  • Pressure class / schedule: Class 150 (150#)

Sizes

12 part numbers, 1/8" to 4". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size for every one.

Pressure rating

These are Class 150 (150#) cast fittings, for moderate-pressure service; the manufacturer publishes no psi table, so tell us the working pressure and temperature and we will confirm the class suits them.

Standards

ASME B1.20.1.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the size, end connection and grade, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Construction

  • Body: pipe nipple

  • Material: 316 stainless steel, welded pipe
  • Pressure class / schedule: Sch 40 welded

Sizes

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for these nipples; a nipple holds what its pipe schedule and thread allow, so tell us the working pressure and we will confirm it.

Standards
